newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent quoted higher as NYMEX rises.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent quoted higher as NYMEX rises.

text.p: August Brent futures were quoted higher on SIMEX on Monday in line with a firmer tone on NYMEX, which brokers attributed to the wait for first crude Iraq exports.
August Brent was untraded but was quoted at the close at $18.18/$18.26 per barrel, up from London's settlement on Friday at $18.09.
August NYMEX crude added 15 cents on ACCESS to the 11 gained in New York to bring the last trade to $19.48 per barrel.
Brokers said uncertainty over the timing of Iraq resumption of crude exports had prompted some short covering.
It seemed the United Nations and Iraq will be holding more discussions on the aid distribution plan -- which is needed to trigger the crude sales, brokers said.
